Netflix deal announced 19 Dec 2025 (Avatar SDK migration guide, PocketGamer.biz: ~20 staff and only CTO Rainer Selvet joined Netflix Games); on 31 Jan 2026 the hosted creator, PlayerZero and public API endpoints went offline (Genies; ryanschultz.com prints 30 Jan). Union Avatars is shut down (VCBacked; unionavatars.com parked; avatarsdk.com 7 Jul 2026), but the founder Cai Felip said on LinkedIn the company closed in mid-2025 while a competitor says 'offline July 2026' -- 'has also closed' is true, the date is 2025 per the founder. Caveat: most sources are competing avatar vendors.

Three searches. The DevForum post 'RDC26: What We Announced' (t/4865880) exists, but no extract mentioned 500 studs, 200 studs or a low-end Android floor; that figure stays researcher-sourced. Correction: the 64-material terrain is the Terrain Early Access Program opened in late June 2026 (MoguraVR, ISP64: paintable materials raised from 23 to 64, including variants; Deusens: hierarchical LOD, terrain data removed from place files), i.e. launched before RDC and shown there, not announced there. 'Roblox Reality' appeared on screen at the keynote labelled Early Access 2027; no official page describing it as an AI video world model was surfaced. Other RDC26 items confirmed: browser play in Chrome with no install by end 2026, offline solo mode by mid-2027, Roblox Everywhere standalone apps.

Official 7.1.8 Materials Featurettes release notes: 'Realistic Mirrors are finally in Second Life', PBR terrain 'on supported regions', 2k textures (4x over 1k, higher upload fee); simulator release 2024-04-13 enabled the server flags; Modemworld lists the Lab viewer as 7.1.8.9375512768, June 2024, with static and dynamic planar mirrors. The exact 10 June date and the 'rendered twice' quote did not appear in any extract (the nearest-probe mechanism was verified in source by the second checker).

additional_findings: Switch 2 confirmed at 23.68M units cumulative at 30 Jun 2026; 3.82M in Apr-Jun 2026 (-34.4% YoY vs the 5.82M launch quarter); FY to Mar 2027 forecast held at 16.5M; 9.46M Switch 2 games sold in the quarter.

IDC via The Register (2 Jan 2026): Apple shipped no Vision Pro in Q1-Q3 2025 after halting manufacturing, relaunched with M5 in Q4 and shipped ~45,000 in 2025 (390,000 in 2024); Meta shipped 1.7M Quest in Q1-Q3 2025, down 16% YoY (a nine-month figure; 2024 base 5.6M); IDC expected the whole MR/VR market to fall 42.8% in 2025. Tech-insider's '-42.3% Quest' and '4,500 Vision Pro' are probably the market-wide decline and a Q4-only figure. VR installed base shrank in 2025; flat-screen-first is the right default.

Lumen Lite is a preset (reported as 'Lumen Lite (Lumen Medium)'): irradiance fields with probe occlusion, up to 2x faster than Lumen High; Epic maps scalability presets to frame-rate targets (Medium = 60 fps on Switch 2 and mid-spec PC). Mesh Terrain and Procedural Vegetation Editor are experimental in 5.8. UE6 reported for 2027 by a secondary outlet.

FSR 4.1 on RDNA 3 is an INT8 re-implementation limited to RX 7000 discrete cards; RDNA 3 APUs/iGPUs (handhelds) are excluded for now, AMD is building a lighter model. Tier B handheld targets on AMD APUs still lack vendor ML upscaling.

DLSS 6x is still officially 'in development'; end users initially reach 5x/6x only through NVIDIA App DLSS Overrides; NVIDIA claims up to +35% fps from 4x to 6x in 4K path-traced titles with latency as the acknowledged cost. Dynamic Multi Frame Generation ships in the same DLSS 4.5 Streamline SDK.

Steam Sept 2026 caveats: RTX 5070 is a 12 GB card; 'Other' (8.82%) is larger than any named card; the +2.30 pt jump is the largest single-month move in Valve's table; 32 GB at 42.22% is a plurality, not a majority.

Roblox RDC26 platform direction: browser play in Chrome with no install by end of 2026; offline solo mode by mid-2027; 'Roblox Everywhere' standalone app distribution 'soon'; Highly Engaged Player monetization threshold cut from 250 to 100 in Nov 2026; 'Roblox Reality' Early Access 2027. Roblox is also heading for a zero-install browser entry tier.

Avatar vendor collapse: Netflix has 'no timeline' for using RPM avatars in its games, so the technology is not returning as a licensable service; Union Avatars had no acquirer and no successor. Post-mortem coverage is almost entirely from competitors (Avatar SDK, Genies).

Second Life shipped the server-side feature flags for mirrors, PBR terrain and 2K textures in a 2024-04-13 simulator release, about two months before the release viewer, and 2K uploads carry a higher fee: a reusable gating pattern (server flag + viewer capability + upload price).
